reference:
looked out at the beautiful Lilliput countryside. The fields were small, just like
my flower beds at home, and even the tallest tree was only as tall as a house!
Everything here was so beautiful, but it all seemed very small compared to what
I was used to.
A few days later, to my surprise, the king and queen paid me a visit. They
were both larger than most of the Lilliputians and dressed in magnificent clothes.
Though I tried very hard, I could not communicate with the king because he
spoke to me in his own language, which I couldn't understand. The crowds
around us were excited and curious, eager to hear what the king was saying.
What a pity! Our language barrier made it impossible for us to understand each
other. Eventually, the king and queen left, leaving the guards to watch over me
and keep the crowds calm.
Word of my bravery and kindness spread quickly throughout Lilliput. This
helped me make a great impression on the king, and he decided to send the
best teachers to help me learn the Lilliputian language. As the Lilliputians found
it difficult to say my name, they decided to call me "Enormous One" in their
language.
The officers wanted to check my belongings first. When I emptied my
pockets, they examined everything with great interest. They found a handkerchief,
a pocket knife, and a large shiny object that made a funny sound. None of them
knew that this large shiny object was a watch because Lilliput had no watches at
all. The thing that really interested them most was a bent piece of metal with a
long tube attached to it. Yes! That was my gun.
